Criteria.TestCondition: All functionality can be accessed and executed using only the keyboard.
Criteria.TesterComment: We could not finish this test, so a person needs to check it. The page has an embedded frame we could not read that we cannot check automatically; please check it works with the keyboard. The page has something that reacts to mouse movement, touch or the scroll wheel that we cannot check automatically; please check it works with the keyboard. Only the first 40 elements were checked for menus that open when the mouse rests on them. We looked for: things a mouse can click that the keyboard never reaches, including inside frames; menus that open when the mouse rests on them; custom controls that ignore Enter and Space; and tooltips with information found nowhere else. Results are for the browser used (version 153.0.8010.12).

Criteria.TestCondition: Individual keystrokes do not require specific timings for activation of functionality.
DisabilityImpact: With Limited Language, Cognitive, and Learning Abilities
Criteria.TesterComment: Nothing on this page asks you to press keys at a certain speed, hold a key down, or press a key several times quickly.

Criteria.TestCondition: There is no keyboard trap.
Criteria.TesterComment: We moved through the whole page with Tab and with Shift+Tab, and keyboard focus never got trapped. The page seems to load more content as you scroll, and the recording could not show all of it; content after the feed was reached only by Shift+Tab from the end.

Criteria.TestCondition: When an interface component receives focus, it does not initiate an unexpected change of context.
DisabilityImpact: With Limited Language, Cognitive, and Learning Abilities
Criteria.TesterComment: We moved keyboard focus to each element we could reach, and none of them opened a new page or window or moved focus somewhere else on its own.

Criteria.TestCondition: The focus order preserves the meaning and operability of the web page.
DisabilityImpact: With Limited Language, Cognitive, and Learning Abilities
Criteria.TesterComment: Keyboard focus moves through the page in an order that follows how it reads, forward and backward. The focus order departs from the reading order (focus jumps back up the page from "Contact" (link) to "DATA SEARCH" (link); focus jumps back up the page from "Science Explorer Digital Library" (link) to "DATA SITES" (link); focus jumps back up the page from "Planetary Science" (link) to "ACROSS" (link)), but it still makes sense: The three flagged jumps are just moves to the next footer column. Each column's links stay together under its heading, and the rest of the order follows the page layout.. If you disagree, tell your assistant.
